ILLEGAL LITHIUM PLANT
EFCC Arrests 14 Chinese Nationals and Nigerian in Ogun

The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 14 Chinese nationals and a Nigerian over an alleged illegal lithium processing operation in Ogun State. The development highlights ongoing concerns about illegal mining activities and regulatory compliance in Nigeria’s solid minerals sector.
